title: Desktop OWASP resource lookup scope
red: DesktopOwaspResourceScopeContractTests failed before implementation because OwaspCoverageView did not use Application.Current.FindResource("IconFont").
implementation: OwaspCoverageView now resolves IconFont from Application.Current, matching the application-level Theme.xaml resource scope already used by the other font resources and preventing the reported IconFont resource-not-found failure.
boundary: No authenticated visual browser/published-EXE smoke claim; Authenticode signing, hosted CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, and production certification remain outside this verification run.
